Definition: to shake (as in the wind), i.e. to quake; figuratively, to be loose morally, worthless or prodigal
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be worthless, be vile, be insignificant, be light; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be worthless, be insignificant; 1a2) to make light of, squander, be lavish with; 2) to shake, tremble, quake; 1a) (Niphal) to shake, quake
